note: Data only. Edit freely; tools/pick_brief.py reads it. Coverage is measured from capsule tags solves_<friction> and path_<path_type>.

frictions.zero_damage_stall: Auto-tools burn charge/durability striking blocks they cannot damage (water, hazards, strict-locked blocks).
frictions.overkill_waste: Damage beyond a block's remaining HP is wasted when it breaks.
frictions.tap_misfires: Fat-finger taps land on the wrong tile on a small phone screen.
frictions.unwanted_splash: Secondary/splash damage hurts blocks the player wants left intact.
frictions.auto_tool_runtime: Auto-tools run out of charge or time and need replacing or feeding.
frictions.tool_wear: Durability drains and tools eventually break.
frictions.fluid_flooding: Water and lava pockets block excavation and spread downhill.
frictions.hazard_clearing: Hazard clusters (obsidian) need perimeter catalysts or special handling.
frictions.depth_awareness: Hard to read z-depth and plan excavation across the whole sheet.
frictions.haul_capacity: Carrying, storing and routing loot (backpack vs paired chest).
frictions.market_saturation: Selling the same ore repeatedly tanks its price.
frictions.wrong_tool_penalty: Using the wrong tool class on a block is slow.
frictions.slow_early_dps: Early tools are slow and the early game drags.
frictions.ore_hunting: Finding veins and knowing what lies beneath a tile.
frictions.backfill_scaffolding: Raising floors and building scaffolding with backfill.
frictions.grime_cleanliness: Accumulated grime locks out fussy vendors.
frictions.house_comfort: Home-base amenities (bed, hearth, pantry) that grant perks, never penalties.
frictions.repair_upkeep: Maintaining and repairing mechanical or magical tools.
frictions.vendor_access: Reaching and unlocking better vendors and offers.
frictions.event_helpers: Aids for emergent events such as the lost-cat chase.

zero_damage_stall.mechanics: React to `on_zero_damage_stall` with `pause_tool` (`pause_durability` / `pause_battery`) and/or `ring_bell`, or lower `battery_drain_mult` / `durability_drain_mult` when `tile.is_strict_locked == 1`.

overkill_waste.mechanics: React to `on_block_break` when `tool.overkill_damage > 0` and apply `deal_splash_damage` (using `tool.overkill_damage * factor`) to `neighbors_4`, `random_neighbor_4`, or `shallowest_neighbor_4`.

tap_misfires.mechanics: Reduce `drunk_drift_px` (`mul` < 1.0 or `clamp`), or clamp `min_hp_clamp` (e.g. `base` 1.0 when `ctx.is_direct_tap == 1`) so accidental taps cannot finish breaking a protected tile.

unwanted_splash.mechanics: When `ctx.is_secondary_damage == 1` (or `ctx.is_direct_tap == 0`), reduce `incoming_damage` (`mul` < 1.0, e.g. 0.15) or set `min_hp_clamp` (`base` >= 1.0) so splash damage never breaks the tile.

auto_tool_runtime.mechanics: Reduce `battery_drain_mult` (`mul` < 1.0), or provide an `automine` tool with generous `charge_left`, or react to `on_second_tick` / `on_offline_catchup`.

tool_wear.mechanics: Reduce `durability_drain_mult` (`mul` < 1.0) so tools lose less durability per swing, or craft a high-durability tool.

fluid_flooding.mechanics: Use a `BUCKET` tool, or react to `on_fluid_contact`, `on_fluid_flow`, `on_zero_damage_stall`, or `on_second_tick` (when `tile.fluid_level > 0`) with `modify_fluid` (`fluid_type: "NONE"`, `delta_level: -1`). Note: solid blocks never break while `tile.fluid_level > 0`.

hazard_clearing.mechanics: Include `catalyst` affordance for perimeter detonation, or react to `on_hazard_expose` / `on_hazard_detonate`, or boost `base_dps` / `incoming_damage` when `tile.is_hazard == 1`.

depth_awareness.mechanics: Use `reveal_contour` on `on_equip`, `on_tap`, or `on_layer_reveal`, and/or grant a precision `luck_mult` or `break_time_mult` bonus on deep or uneven strata.

haul_capacity.mechanics: Increase `chest_route_pct` (`add` 0.25..1.0) so mined ore routes directly to `paired_chest`, or spawn bonus routed loot into `paired_chest` on `on_block_break`.

market_saturation.mechanics: Increase `market_value_mult` (`mul` > 1.0 or `add` > 0.0), or react to `on_market_sell` to grant bonus value or refine raw ore.

wrong_tool_penalty.mechanics: Reduce `wrong_tool_penalty` (`mul` < 1.0, e.g. 0.5) so off-class tools suffer less slowdown.

slow_early_dps.mechanics: Boost `base_dps` (`add` or `mul` > 1.0), increase `incoming_damage` (`mul` > 1.0), or lower `break_time_mult` (`mul` < 1.0) at shallow depth (`tile.depth < 300`).

ore_hunting.mechanics: Increase `luck_mult` (`add` > 0.0 or `mul` > 1.0) and/or `yield_mult` (`mul` >= 1.0), or trigger `reveal_contour` on `on_layer_reveal`.

backfill_scaffolding.mechanics: Include `backfill_material` affordance, or react to `on_backfill` with `modify_depth` / `spawn_item`, or boost mining speed on backfilled tiles (`tile.depth < tile.max_depth_reached`).

grime_cleanliness.mechanics: Reduce `grime_gain_mult` (`mul` < 1.0), or grant a clean-player bonus (`player.grime < 10`) after `on_wash`.

house_comfort.mechanics: Include `place_in_house` affordance; react to `on_enter_house` or `on_sleep`, or grant positive buffs (`base_dps`, `luck_mult`, `yield_mult`) when `player.is_rested == 1`.

repair_upkeep.mechanics: Reduce `durability_drain_mult` or `battery_drain_mult` (`mul` < 1.0), or react to `on_block_break` / `on_second_tick` by consuming common stone/copper (`consume_item`) to restore `self.durability_left` or `self.charge_left`.

vendor_access.mechanics: Increase `vendor_depth_discount` (`add` > 0) or update `shared.reputation_vayne` / `shared.gold_earned_total` via `set_shared_var` on `on_market_sell` or `on_block_break`.

event_helpers.mechanics: Increase `cat_lure_bonus` (`add` 0.01..0.05) or use a `CAPTURE_NET` tool or `ring_bell` reaction on `on_layer_reveal`.

vendor_disposable.hint: An NPC sells a timed or single-use enchanted tool that eventually breaks and vanishes.

skill_book.hint: A bought or found book; level 1 is weak and clumsy, and it may be permanent or timed.

npc_enchanter.hint: An enchanter-service result (rune, scroll, sigil) socketed into any tool you already own, at an exotic cost.

forge_material.hint: A Tinkers-style tool or part whose properties come from its material and mold.

field_textile.hint: A placeable covering or barrier with thickness, wear and a trade-off.

magic_charm.hint: A socketable or carried magical trinket with a clear limiter.

profession_perk.hint: A self-taught profession unlock or house amenity that grants a perk.

consumable_buff.hint: A food, potion or tonic with a timed effect and often a side effect.

qol_upgrade.hint: One granular single-function quality-of-life or HUD aid. Never a bundle.

tool_builtin.hint: A tool that solves the friction natively, with no add-on required.

placeable_device.hint: A gadget placed on a tile that quietly changes how that tile behaves.

hired_laborer.hint: A purchased laborer or automaton that works on its own timer, decoupled from the player.

power_source.hint: A battery, fuel or reagent that feeds or extends an auto-tool.

bundle_package.hint: A very expensive, unlock-gated NPC package that grants several single options at once.

block.hint: A new ore, crystal, soil or hazard stratum. Keep stats.spawn_prob small (0.005 to 0.015), set stats.z_unlock and stats.z_max (e.g. a 200-500 depth band), base_hp, value_base, and ideal_tool; never add offered_by to a natural block.

biome.hint: A rare subterranean pocket mine, geode chamber, or stratum with stats (z_min, z_max, biome_weight) and biome_weights referencing existing blocks (especially under-referenced ores). Never add offered_by to a biome.

npc.hint: A rare specialist guild artisan, runesmith, alchemist, or secret deep-stratum vendor with affordances ["npc_vendor"] and stats.unlock_depth. Items point back at it via their own offered_by; NEVER put offered_by inside an NPC capsule.

tinker_part_forging.title: Tinkers' Modular Part Forging (Head / Rod / Binding)
tinker_part_forging.hint: Cast a modular tool component (`tinker_head`, `tinker_rod`, or `tinker_binding` with `socket_in_tool` affordance) from an exotic stratum ore + secondary flux block so players can socket multiple modular parts into a tool.

terraria_item_fusion.title: Terraria Cumulative Item Fusion (Multi-Item Recipe)
terraria_item_fusion.hint: Combine 1 existing lower-tier tool or device capsule PLUS 1-2 stratum ores inside `offered_by[].price` to forge a cumulative upgraded tool or relic that merges their themes.

skyrim_arcane_enchanting.title: Skyrim Arcane Enchanting & Resonance Sigils
skyrim_arcane_enchanting.hint: A socketable arcane sigil stone or rune (`socket_in_tool`) gated by `shared.quarry_resonance_charge` or depth, forged from crystal/ore strata, that binds an elemental or seismic proc onto any tool.

alchemy_multi_reagent.title: Skyrim / RPG Multi-Reagent Alchemy & Decoctions
alchemy_multi_reagent.hint: Brew a multi-ingredient potion, elixir, or phial whose `offered_by[].price` combines 2-3 distinct raw strata (fluids, soils, mineral salts) for a potent timed buff with an alchemical quirk.

geomancy_spell_grimoire.title: Arcane Grimoire & Quarry Geomancy Spell
geomancy_spell_grimoire.hint: An arcane spell tome or incantation (`read_book` or `consume`) that casts active quarry geomancy: transmuting rock (`transform_tile`), evaporating fluids (`modify_fluid`), shifting depth (`modify_depth`), or chaining damage (`deal_damage`).

smeltery_alloy_refining.title: Smeltery Alloying & Crucible Transmutation
smeltery_alloy_refining.hint: A crucible catalyst or kiln apparatus that consumes raw ore/slag (`consume_item`) on break or tick and refines/transmutes it (`spawn_item` or `set_shared_var`) into higher-tier material or resonance.

rpg_skill_mastery_tree.title: Expandable Modular Skill Bracket & Guild Mastery Node
rpg_skill_mastery_tree.hint: Create a permanent, expandable Skill Bracket node at `upgrades/<slug>/capsule.json` (NEVER books/: books can self-destruct and re-lock recipes) tagged `"skill_bracket"`, `"bracket_<1..5>"`, `"skill_school_<slug>"` and `"theme_<slug>"`. It MUST have its own `offered_by` (an unobtainable skill is rejected by Law L13). Future recipes reference its capsule ID in `offered_by[].price` as a non-consumed requirement.

achievement_milestone_relic.title: Quarry Achievement Seal & Milestone Trophy
achievement_milestone_relic.hint: An unlockable trophy seal whose `offered_by[].unlock_if` requires proving a quarry feat (deep `player.max_depth`, `tool.tier >= 3`, `shared.quarry_resonance_charge`, or `shared.house_bell_ringing`) and grants a permanent passive aura.

homestead_workshop_station.title: Homestead Workshop Bench & Architecture
homestead_workshop_station.hint: A crafted homestead bench or architectural fixture (`place_in_house` affordance) built from multiple mineral strata that permanently enhances rested state, clean-hands bonuses, market value, or tool upkeep, and can act as a non-consumed station requirement in future recipes.

clockwork_field_automaton.title: Clockwork Automaton & Autonomous Field Rig
clockwork_field_automaton.hint: A multi-part engineered quarry rig (`place_on_tile` affordance, `offline: "coarse"` or `"exact"`) forged from metal/rivet/cinder strata that autonomously mines, siphons fluids, or dampens hazards.

bracket_1.title: Bracket I — Novice / Frontier Initiate
bracket_1.lore_epoch: The Brass Ledger Frontier (Surface Claim & Sunken Bog)
bracket_1.recipe_rule: 1-2 shallow strata blocks; introduces foundational tools, apprentice skill brackets (`skill_school_<slug>`), or basic workshop benches.

bracket_2.title: Bracket II — Apprentice / Journeyman Artisan
bracket_2.lore_epoch: The Calcified Foundry (Drowned Steam-Baronies of Rivet & Slag)
bracket_2.recipe_rule: Requires a Bracket I Skill/Station or lower-tier item + 1-2 Foundry-depth strata ores in `offered_by[].price`.

bracket_3.title: Bracket III — Adept / Guild Specialist
bracket_3.lore_epoch: The Scriptorium of Hollow Quill (Monastic Lithic Archivists & Brine Vaults)
bracket_3.recipe_rule: Requires a Bracket II Skill/Station or prerequisite tool + 2 mid-strata ores/reagents in `offered_by[].price`.

bracket_4.title: Bracket IV — Master / Deep-Stratum Savant
bracket_4.lore_epoch: The Crucible of the Under-Sun (Basal Pyromancers & 8-Perimeter Obsidian Wardens)
bracket_4.recipe_rule: Requires a Bracket III Skill/Station + 1 prerequisite item/tool + 1-2 deep strata blocks in `offered_by[].price`.

bracket_5.title: Bracket V — Grandmaster / Abyssal Confluence
bracket_5.lore_epoch: The Singing Abyss & Paradox Ledger (Tectonic Harmonic Convergence)
bracket_5.recipe_rule: Endgame Confluence uniting multiple systems: requires a Master Skill/Station + prerequisite gear/reagent + deep stratum block in `offered_by[].price`.

theme_tectonic_crucible.title: The Grand Crucible of the Tectonic Leviathan
theme_tectonic_crucible.lore: Ancient smith-lords of the Under-Sun Manifold who bound magma veins and anvilstone into self-tempering thermal drills and crucible transmutation rigs.

theme_lithic_choir.title: The Infinite Scriptorium of the Lithic Choir
theme_lithic_choir.lore: Blind monastic archivists of Quill Hollow who discovered that bedrock is frozen acoustic music, using zero-damage stalls and bell harmonics to shatter equal-depth contours.

theme_clockwork_syndicate.title: The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate
theme_clockwork_syndicate.lore: The sunken steam-baronies and horologists who built self-feeding wind-up automatons, pneumatic paired-chest tubes, and autonomous deep-bore railways.

theme_alkahest_hydro.title: The Alkahest Vitriol & Abyssal Hydro-Works
theme_alkahest_hydro.lore: Subterranean hydro-alchemists who treat the 14x31 quarry as a terraced chemical alembic, flooding strata with brine and vitriol to soften and transmute rock before siphoning it dry.

theme_obsidian_wardbreaker.title: The Sovereign Ward-Breakers of the Obsidian Seal
theme_obsidian_wardbreaker.lore: Siege geomancers and catalyst-sappers sworn to cracking the 1% strict-locked Obsidian Hazard seals via 8-perimeter equal-depth catalyst detonations and blast-shield textiles.

theme_munchkin_paradox.title: The Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin
theme_munchkin_paradox.lore: A secret order of subterranean bureaucrats, sommeliers, and stray-cat whisperers who exploit hilarious literal loopholes in the laws of physics, intoxication, and wrong-tool penalties.

theme_enclave_first_forge.title: The Enclave First Forge & Stormbreaker Concordance
theme_enclave_first_forge.lore: Sympathetic core-metallurgy and captured-lightning geode smithing pioneered by The Forge Squad (Silas, Leo, Hector, Jane) of the Enclave of the 16, where hyper-dense alloys shift resonance with operator focus and grounding rods tame subterranean plasma.

theme_enclave_living_atlas.title: The Living Atlas & Mycelial Sanctuary of the Enclave
theme_enclave_living_atlas.lore: Bioluminescent spore cartography, magnetotropic flora cultivation, and Schrödinger's Harvest culinary alchemy shared across The Wilds, The Mind, and The Hub of the Enclave of the 16.

canonical.hint: CANONICAL LOGIC (Strict Metallurgical / Industrial Sense): Directly match the item's material, function, and name to the assigned specialist NPC, Skill Bracket, and assigned stratum ore.

plausible.hint: PLAUSIBLE LOGIC (Cross-Discipline Craft / Alloy): Combine two complementary materials or upgrade an existing item logically across adjacent skill schools.

whimsical.hint: WHIMSICAL LOGIC (Quarry Folk-Science / Clever Twist): Use playful subterranean folk-logic or a witty pun connection while still delivering a genuinely useful mechanical effect.

absurd.hint: MUNCHKIN-ABSURD LOGIC (Rule-Bending Comedy with Real Value): Channel the card game Munchkin—an outrageously funny, over-the-top contraption, potion, or spell with a legitimate mechanical payoff AND a hilarious situational quirk.

twists: Give it one clear limiter: a cost, a bounded charge/durability, or a situational condition.
Gate its vendor offer with an unlock_if expression on a declared shared register.
Make it disposable: it wears down after a bounded amount of use (`durability_left` or `charge_left`).
Make it trade speed for precision, or precision for speed.
Give it a mild situational trade-off that rewards thoughtful placement.
Price it in a multi-ingredient recipe (2-3 existing blocks or 1 existing item + 1-2 blocks) rather than a single common block.
Make it an early-tier apprentice version with modest numbers and clear identity.
Make it specialize strongly in deep strata (`tile.depth >= 500`) or high-tier rock (`tile.tier >= 1`).
Make it synergize with rested state (`player.is_rested == 1`) or clean hands (`player.grime < 15`).
Make it permanent while carried or placed in the house, with a focused single-stat effect.
Make it thrifty and reliable for an early-game miner.
Make it conditional on tile depth, tier, hazard state, or fluid level.
